title: Practice: Through, past and around: про- and об-

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These sentences and their English translations were written by people on Tatoeba (tatoeba.org), shared under CC BY 2.0 FR. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.prompt: A murmur went through the audience.
exercises.why: «про-»: пробежать. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«про-»: проводить. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: Did you have a good Easter?
exercises.why: «про-»: провести. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«про-»: пройти. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«про-»: проехать. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Над их головами бесшумно ___ (пролететь) большая стая грачей.
exercises.prompt: A great flight of rooks passed silently over their heads.
exercises.why: «про-»: пролететь. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Я ___ (оббегать) весь город в попытках занять немного денег.
exercises.prompt: I ran all over town trying to borrow some money.
exercises.why: «об-»: оббегать. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: Rio's carnival is held in February.
exercises.why: «про-»: проходить. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: Tom runs three or four miles a day.
exercises.why: «про-»: пробегать. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: Tom circled the word with his pencil.
exercises.why: «об-»: обвести. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: How many laps did you swim?
exercises.why: «про-»: проплыть. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Том ___ (пронести) в палату Мэри бутылку виски.
exercises.prompt: Tom smuggled a bottle of whiskey into Mary's hospital room.
exercises.why: «про-»: пронести. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: My father traveled all over the world by air.
exercises.why: «об-»: облететь. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«про-»: проплывать. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
